step_coverage.expect: Email and password fields and a "Sign in" button are visible
Member's name and a list of past orders are shown
step_coverage.reason: Member's name is asserted; the past-orders list has no stable selector (GAP-001)

step_coverage.expect: "Email or password is incorrect" error; user stays on /login
Locked-account message with a reset-password link
Product page shows title, price and an enabled "Add to cart" button
Checkout form shows shipping and card fields; "Pay now" is disabled
Confirmation page shows an order number
Inline "Your card was declined" error; user stays on the checkout page
"Add to cart" is disabled and shows "Out of stock"
App opens directly on the product screen
step_coverage.reason: Mobile deep link (ios, android): the repository has no mobile UI test framework. Proposed Maestro or Detox; not installed without agreement.

testability_gaps.problem: Rendered as nested <div class="row"> elements with no list role, heading or test id; only CSS classes identify it.
testability_gaps.suggestion: Render the orders as <ul aria-label="Past orders"> (or add data-testid="order-history"), then assert the list has at least one item.
